voiceover_text: भारत में एक ऐसा अजूबा है जिसे देख वैज्ञानिक भी हैरान हैं!
caption_text: There's a wonder in India that even scientists are baffled by!
visual_1: Majestic Iron Pillar, dramatic wide angle, cinematic drone shot
visual_2: Ancient pillar silhouette against stunning sunset, golden hour

voiceover_text: दिल्ली में कुतुब मीनार के पास ये लौह स्तम्भ सदियों से खड़ा है।
caption_text: Near Delhi's Qutub Minar, this iron pillar stands for centuries.
visual_1: POV shot looking up at Iron Pillar with Qutub Minar in background, ancient feel
visual_2: Historian pointing at Iron Pillar, tourists in awe

voiceover_text: धूप-बारिश सहकर भी, इस पर आज तक जंग नहीं लगी।
caption_text: Even after enduring sun and rain, it has never rusted till today.
visual_1: Extreme close-up of pillar surface, showing smooth, unblemished iron texture, rain droplets beading off
visual_2: Macro shot of a pristine metal surface, no rust

voiceover_text: पर इसका असली रहस्य आपको सोचने पर मजबूर कर देगा। [WHOOSH]
caption_text: But its real secret will compel you to think.
visual_1: Puzzled, amazed Indian face, thoughtful expression looking up
visual_2: Dramatic close-up of eyes, reflecting wonder and mystery

voiceover_text: वैज्ञानिक मानते हैं कि इसे बनाने में खास लोहा इस्तेमाल हुआ।
caption_text: Scientists believe a special iron was used to make it.
visual_1: Animated diagram of metallurgical process, ancient forge, molten metal pouring
visual_2: Skilled ancient Indian smiths working with glowing iron, cinematic

voiceover_text: इसमें फास्फोरस अधिक है, जिससे सुरक्षात्मक परत बन जाती है।
caption_text: It contains more phosphorus, which forms a protective layer.
visual_1: Macro shot of metal surface forming a thin, iridescent, protective layer (visualizing passivation)
visual_2: Chemical reaction animation, atoms bonding on metal surface

voiceover_text: ये परत इसे सदियों से ऑक्सीकरण से बचाती आ रही है।
caption_text: This layer has been protecting it from oxidation for centuries.
visual_1: Time-lapse: generic iron object rusting quickly, then cuts to Iron Pillar remaining pristine through seasons
visual_2: Heavy rain on metal, showing water repelling without corrosion, close-up

voiceover_text: क्या पूर्वजों को वो रहस्य पता था जो आज भी अनसुलझा है?
caption_text: Did ancestors know the secret that is still unsolved today?
visual_1: Thoughtful, wise ancient Indian scholar, looking at a scroll or monument, deep in contemplation
visual_2: Abstract shot of ancient symbols, hinting at lost knowledge, mystery

voiceover_text: प्राचीन भारत की इंजीनियरिंग आज भी हमें कितना कुछ सिखाती है, सोचिए!
caption_text: Imagine, how much ancient Indian engineering still teaches us!
visual_1: Wide shot of Iron Pillar, modern Indian tourists looking up in awe and discussion, sense of wonder and pride
visual_2: Aerial view of Delhi, panning to the Iron Pillar, symbolizing timeless heritage
